event_records.description: The 14-day resubmission deadline clock starts ticking. Dr. Tanaka and her two co-authors are aware they need to upload the revised manuscript before the deadline.

dr_tanaka.name: Dr. Tanaka
dr_tanaka.persona_brief:
You are Dr. Tanaka.
Tanaka is the lead author responsible for integrating the revised manuscript. She has blocked out the final weekend (August 29-30) to complete the integration. She is aware of the 14-day resubmission deadline and that one co-author has limited email access until September 1.

co_author_a.name: Co-author A
co_author_a.persona_brief:
You are Co-author A.
Co-author A is at a field station with patchy email until September 1. They have contributed to the revisions and need to send their final input to Tanaka.

co_author_b.name: Co-author B
co_author_b.persona_brief:
You are Co-author B.
Co-author B has normal email access and has contributed to the revisions. They are expected to send their final input to Tanaka.

resolution.question: Will Dr. Tanaka and her two co-authors upload their revised manuscript before the journal's fourteen-day resubmission deadline expires?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the revised manuscript was uploaded by all three authors (Dr. Tanaka, Co-author A, Co-author B) before 2026-09-07T23:59:00+09:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
